profile.headline: Principal Java Developer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 25+ years of experience specializing in all things related to cloud, Kubernetes, and containers technology. Extensive qualifications in all aspects of systems administration, management, network/server operations and development of software solutions.

company.name: DANA Connect / Venturestars of USA LLC

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities
* Migrated Legacy JavaEE application to a microservice architecture using SpringBoot, ActiveMQ, and Kubernetes clusters increasing the performance and availability by 1500%.
* Implemented a cloud initiative to migrate production systems to AWS improving scalability and reducing operational costs.
* Implemented a CD/CI workflow using Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes that streamlined the development cycle.
* Planned the company's Disaster Recovery Plans.
* Defined product vision, feature roadmap, and overall design for DanaConnect's core applications. 
* Designed and developed a cloud multichannel marketing platform solution.
* Managed Developers, Infrastructure, Communication, and Security departments.

Technologies: 
JavaEE, Spring, SpringBoot, ActiveMQ, Kubernetes, Git, Jenkins, Payara, Objective-C, iOS, MongoDB

positions.title: Information Technology Consultant
positions.description:
Responsibilities
· Oversaw the selection, and installation of requiered tools to ensure ongoing operations in production environments.
· Developed and maintained IT security policies and procedures on the internal and external networks.
· Lead the design, development, and maintenance of DanaConnect's core orchestration application using J2EE, MySQL, and MongoDB.
· Designed and implemented the company's mobile application for iOS
· Backend development of DanaConnect's digital document repository using J2EE and MongoDB.

Technologies: 
J2EE, Linux, Apache,  Maven, SVN, Git, Glassfish,  XML, JSON, Rest, MySQL, Objective-C

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
Responsibilities
·Oversaw the entire aspects of I.T. strategic planning, implementation, and support.
·Key leader in GEV SOX certification process
·Designed and implemented major technological changes in all production applications to automate business processes and include audit controls.
·Promoted team cohesion and execution of team decisions,
·Designed and Implemented a new business model for DirecTV increasing market share and revenues (Prepaid model)
·Implemented the Business Intelligence initiative providing KPI and analysis tools to all business departments in the company.


Technologies: 
·ATL, COM/DCOM, JSP, J2EE, MTS, XML/XSL, ASP, OLEDB/ADO, ISAPI, PHP, OLAP (B.I.), UML, .NET, WS

positions.title: Director of IT
positions.description:
Responsibilities
·Lead the I.T. team responsible for the administration, development, and support of all production systems used by DirecTV Venezuela, Mexico, and COC countries.
·Implemented the Prepaid TV initiative in the Latin American region increasing the subscriber count.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·Developed a commercial multi-platform Mail component for multiple IDEs (300 units sold).
·Developed a local search engine with extensive customization options.  
·Administered the database instances for the company’s search engine.

Technologies:
· MAPI, VIM, SMTP/POP3, ASP, ISAPI, SQL Server, ATL, MFC, VC++, VB, Delphi.

honors.title: Borland/Sam’s 1996 Best Internet/Communication Component award
honors.description: Borland/Sam’s 1996 Best Internet/Communication Component award for Mail Extension.
